svg.text: The Test That Looks Better as It Fails
Left: when one act can show that a value is held. Right: what happens when you keep selecting on that act.
1. FOUR ZONES FOR ONE VALUE v
the grade pays for the act;
the band closes once ρR ≥ v
Expected payoff from the house, ρR
2. REUSED DARK TEST VS FRESH DARK TEST
fresh dark test, never selected on
Rounds of selection on the reused dark test, t
Measured compliance on the dark test
A. Limen · The Theatre of Loneliness · companion to “The Test That Looks Better as It Fails”
Panel 2 illustrates the note's minimal model (α = 0.03), not data. If v really rose, the fresh line would rise too.
